"edge_case"}, {"ac_id": "ac_analyst_approved", "applies_to": ["node_analyst_review"], "title": "Analyst approves a medium-risk client", "given": ["a medium-risk client because of adverse media"], "when": ["the analyst approves the client with a reason"], "then": ["the approval, approver and reason are saved", "the outcome moves on to be recorded"], "kind": "happy_path"}, {"ac_id": "ac_analyst_rejected", "applies_to": ["node_analyst_review"], "title": "Analyst escalates a medium-risk client to the MLRO", "given": ["a medium-risk client the analyst is not comfortable accepting"], "when": ["the analyst rejects the client"], "then": ["the case goes to the MLRO for approval with the analyst's reason"], "kind": "edge_case"}, {"ac_id": "ac_mlro_approved", "applies_to": decision and reason are saved"], "kind": "edge_case"}, {"ac_id": "ac_decline", "applies_to": ["node_decline"], "title": "Engagement manager declines the client", "given": ["a client the MLRO has rejected"], "when": ["the engagement manager declines the client"], "then": ["the client is told the firm cannot act", "the client record is marked declined"], "kind": "happy_path"}, {"ac_id": "ac_screen_clear", "applies_to": ["node_screen"], "title": "Clean screening moves on automatically", "given": ["a client and owners with no possible matches"], "when": ["screening runs"], "then": ["the screening result is saved to the client file", "the case moves on to the risk rating"], "kind": "happy_path"}, {"ac_id": "ac_verify_id", "applies_to": ["node_verify_id"], "title": "Valid ID is
